The Contracting Agency will submit the GeM invoice per month along with proof of disbursement after making the payment to the employees deployed to the PM SHRI KENDRIYA VIDYALAYA AFS OJHAR, supported with the following documents: - i) The Contracting Agency will ensure payment of the monthly remuneration through ban k transfer only i.e. RTGS/NEFT/UPI etc. to the Security Guard deployed by them in PM SHR I KENDRIYA VIDYALAYA AFS OJHAR, by the 5th of every succeeding month. ii) Copy of Bank Statement containing details of net payment disbursed to the respective bank account of the Guard deployed. iii) Wages sheet containing full details of salary disbursed to the security Guard deployed. The net payment shall tally with the amount credited in the Bank Account of the security Guard. iv) The Attendance of the Security Guard will mandatorily punch on Bio Metric Machine Pro vided by The Contracting Agency every day. Monthly Attendance Certificate duly will be c ertified by the Service Provider. The monthly bill generated shall be verified with the Act ual attendance punched by all the Guards deployed during the month. v) Proof of payment of statutory obligation such as EPF, ESI etc. It will be verified as per the copy of EPF/ ESIC payment Challan & ECR attached. Actual reimbursement of EPF/ESI C will be made as per amount credited /paid in the respective security Guard’s account. vi) Payment to the Contracting Agency will be released after the verification of receip t of the invoice and the other above mentioned documents. vii) The rates of minimum wages to be paid will be as & when revised by the Chie f Labour Commissioner during the contract period. viii) The Contracting Agency will provide Identity Card to all his employees deployed as per the format suggested by the Indenting Office valid for the period of contract. ix) Security Guard shall always be in the uniform dress, which will be provided by the Cont racting Agency. x) The Security Guards will be deployed for round the clock. The duty hours of 01 Securit y Guard will be 08 hours duty per day. xi) As per rules, each Security Guard shall be given weekly off and Agency will ensure to d eploy another Guard in his place xii) In case of absence of any Guard on any working day, the contractor will deploy another Guard immediately. xiii) The monthly remuneration will be regulated as per the following formula: Total monthly remuneration = Monthly remuneration X No. of days present No. of days in the month Contd…..2/- -------- 2 --------- 3. The Candidates/Manpower provided by the Contracting Agency shall be accepted only after scree ning & scrutiny by PM SHRI KENDRIYA VIDYALAYA AFS OJHAR. Therefore, sufficient number of bio- data shall be made available against each slot for choosing the suitable candidate. No conveyan ce or any other charges will be paid by PM SHRI KENDRIYA VIDYALAYA AFS OJHAR, for screening / scrutiny. In case, no candidate is found suitable then additional bio-data shall be made available by the Contracting Agency immediately. The replacement of a candidate on account of unauthori zed long absence/unsuitability for KV shall be made within 24 hours. 4. The Contracting Agency will be required to sign a contract with the PM SHRI KENDRIYA VIDYALAY A AFS OJHAR, as per the Model Contract. The other terms and conditions specified in the Bid docu ment and accepted bid will be from the part of the Model Agreement. 5. In case of any loss, theft/sabotage caused by/attributable to the personnel deployed, the PM SHRI KENDRIYA VIDYALAYA AFS OJHAR reserves the right to claim and recover damages from the Cont racting Agency.

Failing to provide the copy of the valid certificate the bid will be liable for Disqualification.
